info.description: API Server for Finance Service Application
info.title: Finance Service API

get.description: Return all accounts in the active workspace (flat list, tree is built client-side).

post.description: Create a new account in the active workspace.
Seed chart of accounts using preset profile and language.

get.description: Get a single account by ID.

put.description: Update mutable fields of an account. Code, type and currency cannot be changed.

get.description: Return journal entries with pagination and filters.

post.description: Create a new double-entry journal entry with postings.

get.description: Get a single journal entry by ID.
Return exchange rates with optional filtering.

post.description: Create a new currency exchange rate.

delete.description: Delete an exchange rate entry by ID.

get.description: Get a single exchange rate entry by ID.

put.description: Update rate or source of an exchange rate entry.

get.description: Return all ledger periods in the active workspace.

post.description: Create a new ledger period in the active workspace.

delete.description: Delete a ledger period by ID.

get.description: Get a single ledger period by ID.

put.description: Update status of a ledger period following transition: open -> closed -> locked.
